current_events: Pope Leo XIV approves Filipino cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle's election as dean of the College of Cardinals, making him the first Asian to lead the body that elects a new pope

Isaias strengthens into a category 3 Atlantic hurricane. It would later weaken to category 2, with 365,000 customers in Alabama and Florida, United States, reported to be without power ahead of its landfall
Isaias makes landfall near Destin, Florida, and weakens to a category 1 hurricane
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes Herrera Province, Panama. A nationwide tsunami warning is issued
A passenger bus collides with a truck on a road in Mkambarani, Morogoro Region, Tanzania, and catches fire, killing 28 people
Montenegro expels Russian milblogger Mikhail Zvinchuk and four other Russian nationals on national security grounds after detaining them in Risan
South African judge and former United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay is awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for "her efforts to promote peace and international law"

Clashes erupt in New York City, United States, between protestors and police after the shooting of a man from the Dominican Republic by ICE agents. The man, who was in a car alongside a child, was then detained while being wounded
Shootings by U.S. immigration agents in the second Trump administration

The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court issues an arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro, the brother of presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, on charges of lobbying the U.S. to interfere in the trial of his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro
Nine people are killed during a shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania, United States
Czechs begin voting in the first round to elect one-third of the Senate. Incumbent prime minister Andrej Babiš seeks gains of his coalition in the Senate
